_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. elevenreader.io declares a Tailwind v4 token layer (--themed-* RGB triplets bound into --color-* roles, a --f-* type scale, --font-*, --spacing-*, --container-*) and paints every public surface light; the stylesheet's .dark scope inverts the same triplets but no public page applies it, so the dark set is a declared inversion, not a painted surface. Declared variables become var leaves; painted values without a variable are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.

inter.description: Inter (+ its 'Inter Fallback' metrics clone): every UI, body and form text on the public surface.

waldenburg.description: Waldenburg: the display face on h1s, pricing/audiobook titles, section heads and the FAQ.

normal.description: 400 — body, UI labels, the Waldenburg book weight.

medium.description: 500 — SSO buttons, badges, rail links, footer columns.

bold.description: 700 — the declared f-* bold steps (uppercase UI labels).

display.description: The painted Waldenburg weight on h1s (400 — the f-heading steps declare 700 but the loaded book face paints lighter).
